title: JourneyState v1
description: Session-scoped AAA journey model for one visitor session under one Site Profile version. Raw observations (raw.signals) are kept separate from AAA-derived states (derived). Exists only after consent. When it crosses the network it is an untrusted client observation, never authoritative.

lastSeq.description: seq of the last raw signal applied to this state.

page.description: The current page instance and revision.

signals.description: Raw canonical signals retained for this session, oldest first. Retention cap is set by the collector (AAA-9), not by this contract.

facets.description: Current profile-declared facet values with provenance. explicit values come from facet.selected; inferred values are derived by AAA.

derived.description: AAA-derived states. Always inferred; never emitted as raw signals.

sourceSignalIds.description: Raw signals this value was observed in or inferred from.

derivedState.description: Tri-state so that consumers can apply their own policy to uncertainty. How uncertain is treated (PRD §5) is a consumer policy (D16), not part of this contract.

basisSignalIds.description: Raw signals that produced the current status.

ruleId.description: Profile moment rule or derivation that set the status.
